source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
3. Write an introduction explaining the advertisement, and the test results.
4. Text should clearly state the problem, the products tested, and the test results.
5. Use "failed advertisement" appropriately.
6. Update all the documents mentioned in your documentation related to your product and the advertisement if possible.
7. Include the following: 1. What the advertisement said.
8. Brief Explanation of the test results.
9. Table of test results, as necessary.
10. Include details of all the people involved in the process of writing the report
11. List in the order they are mentioned in the advertisements.
12. Add any other information that may make the report a bit more accurate and unbiased.
13. Confirm the ad copy is the same as what the consumer will see.
14. Use proper advertising terminology and don't use the word cheap where any related words are
